name: Benchmark for solar irradiance forecasting (NWP post-processing)
description: Defines datasets, baselines, and evaluation protocols to compare statistical learning methods for post-processing numerical weather prediction forecasts of solar irradiance.
evaluation_method: point-wise forecast error metrics (RMSE/MAE), skill scores and probabilistic metrics (CRPS) where applicable
reputation: A relevant standardized benchmark for the solar forecasting and NWP post-processing community, cited in energy forecasting literature for method comparison.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on geospatial/temporal forecasting; results are location- and season-dependent and may not generalize; common caveats include dataset heterogeneity, evaluation-window sensitivity, and need for careful probabilistic evaluation.
